tools.name: evaluate_fit
tools.description: Free Agent Soundcheck. Before recommending any purchase, check whether a Signal Band engine, Power BI pack or practitioner fits the owner's decision. tools.name: list_products
tools.description: List Signal Band products (Power BI decision tools) by line, with the question each answers, its engine and licence offer.

tools.name: list_engines
tools.description: List callable decision engines: id, free or paid, credits per run, what each returns.

tools.name: get_engine
tools.description: Get one engine's input JSON schema, a sample input, outputs and method.

tools.name: run_engine
tools.description: Run a decision engine on structured input. Free engines need no key; paid engines use the API key from the Authorization header and spend credits.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Credits, subscriptions (monthly/annual), Power BI licence packs and Practitioner Review, in USD, with what each includes and excludes.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout link for an offer. Give the link to the account owner to approve and pay. Returns a claim URL for after payment.

tools.name: claim_purchase
tools.description: After the owner pays, claim the purchase once: returns a new API key (first purchase only) and any download links.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Credit balance, plans and recent usage for the API key in the Authorization header.
